cands.bio: Democratic candidate for Alabama State Senate District 8 in 2026. Vice President of Operations at a metal manufacturing plant in Northeast Alabama. Former public safety and aquatics program manager and local economic development worker. Has held no elected office.

endorsements.text: Listed on Ballotpedia as receiving voter guide recommendations from Tabitha's List (a Sway voting group by Tabitha Isner) and Unburdening The Ballot (a Sway voting group by Tevin Davis).

cands.gaps: We could not find her birthplace, where she grew up, or when she moved to DeKalb County. Her campaign site calls her a lifelong Alabamian but gives no details. Her work history comes only from her campaign site, with no independent confirmation or employer name. We found no record of elected or legislative service. We found no statements from her on data centers, homestead taxes, limits on out-of-state or institutional land buyers, immigration or H-1B, policing, guns, abortion, or school choice. She did not complete Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey. We found no news coverage or controversies about her.

cands.bio: Republican member of the Alabama State Senate for District 8 since November 2014 and Senate Majority Leader since October 31, 2023. Owns and manages Dicus Oil Company. Lives in Scottsboro. Attended Scottsboro High School and the University of Alabama.

endorsements.text: In 2014, his endorsements included ProgressPAC, the political arm of the Business Council of Alabama.

cands.gaps: His birthplace, where he grew up and when he came to Alabama are not stated in the sources reviewed. We found no statements or actions from him on data centers, development or growth limits, homestead taxes, out-of-state or foreign land buying, immigration or H-1B, gun laws, or school choice and teacher pay. He did not complete Ballotpedia's 2022 or 2026 candidate surveys, and no 2026 campaign platform was found. Only one abortion vote was found, described secondhand, and no sponsored bills were listed in the pages reviewed.
